t: Macworld 1997: The return of Steve Jobs

q.x: > Apple will publicly announce that […] it will make Internet Explorer the default Worth watching for the crowd reaction: [link]

desc:
At the 1997 Macworld Expo (August 5-8) in Boston, Steve Jobs announced that Apple would be entering into partnership with Microsoft. Included in this was a five-year commitment from Microsoft to release Microsoft Office for Macintosh as well a US$150 million investment in Apple. 

Steve Jobs' presentation started with Apple's status report. His expression was very relaxed and has a continuous flow

recs.x:
Check out Steve Job's first keynote after returning to Apple in 1997 starting at 18:35. He enumerates the assets the company still has at its disposable to claw its way out of almost imminent bankruptcy. He specifically mentiones creative proffesionals and educators and backs them up with some interesting stats.
